How X-Men connects

  • Character: Wolverine — Wolverine is an X-Men mainstay.
  • Concept: Mutants — The X-Men defend mutantkind.
  • Topic: Marvel — The X-Men are central to Marvel.

What is X-Men?

The X-Men are mutants who fight for coexistence, including Wolverine, while facing Magneto and anti-mutant prejudice across Marvel comics and adaptations.

Key threads lead to Wolverine, Mutants and Marvel.
